Job Description:

This is an open continuous vacancy announcement that will be
used to fill adjunct vacancies as they occur. Until you hear from a
representative of the Department of Economics or the Office of HR
Faculty, please continue to also apply directly to other positions
posted on AU's website.

The Department of Economics in the College of Arts and Sciences at
American University invites applications for a number of adjunct
faculty positions for upcoming Academic Years. Rank will depend on
an applicant’s highest degree earned in Economics or a closely
related field. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling
basis.

The Department of Economics offers both undergraduate and graduate
degree programs. The Department is organized under the College of
Arts and Sciences, which is where scholarship in the Arts,
Humanities, and Sciences is pursued. Learn more about the College
of Arts and Sciences at https://www.american.edu/cas/ and the
Department of Economics at https://www.american.edu/cas/economics/ .

The Department of Economics in the College of Arts and Sciences has
the following adjunct salary ranges:
